title: Faraday's Law
text: Faraday's Law states: EMF = -N * (d(phi)/dt), where N is the number of turns, and d(phi)/dt is the rate of change of magnetic flux.

title: Calculate EMF
text: EMF = -200 * (-0.015 / 0.2) = -200 * (-0.075) = 15 V. The negative signs cancel, giving a positive EMF magnitude.
